title: Ignore constraints other than `FixAtoms` and `FixCartesian` in `write_extxyz` properly
body:
Closes #1752

The present MR solves the above issue by ignoring constraints other than `FixAtoms` and `FixCartesian` in `write_extxyz`.

The issue occurred when `move_mask` is present in the argument `columns` in `write_extxyz`.
While the issue had probably existed for a long time, this gets more visible after ASE 3.26.0, as `move_mask` gets included in `columns` by default (!3713).
